name: Isometric
when: Explaining a process, a journey or how something works step by step: an order reaching a door, data moving through a system, a service from sign-up to result.
look: A small isometric world in soft pastel colours, objects drawn as clean 30-degree blocks, a glowing item travelling between stops with labels
pace: Steady: the camera glides from stop to stop, about 2.5-3 s a step, each label popping as the item arrives
